3.The graph of the piecewise-defined function fis shown in the figure above. The graph has a
vertical tangent line at x = -2 and horizontal tangent lines at x = -3 and x = -1. What are all
values of x, -4 < x < 3. at which fis continuous but not differentiable?
(A) x=1
(B) x=-2 and x=0
(C) x=-2 and x=1
(D) x=0 and x=1
